content_sections.heading: About PRSU
content_sections.text: Pt. Ravishankar Shukla University (PRSU) is a university in Raipur, Chhattisgarh. These posts are in its SoS in Ancient Indian History Culture and Archaeology. They are for the DST-SHRI project "Metal art of Chhattisgrah: A Socio- Techno Analysis", which the Department of Science and Technology funds.

content_sections.text: The PRSU DST-SHRI project has 2 posts in total. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? Test Yourself! 25 Questions · 20 Minutes · Instant Score Take Today's Free Quiz →

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice gives separate requirements for each post: For the JRF post, CSIR/UGC NET is part of the essential qualification. Field work experience in Archaeology is only desirable. For the Project Fellow post, the notice lists experience of handling analytical instruments as an essential qualification, alongside the M. Sc. in Chemistry. For the full eligibility of each post, check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Both posts pay a monthly fellowship with 20% HRA added: Rs. 31,000/- + 20% HRA for the JRF and Rs. 25,000/- + 20% HRA for the Project Fellow. The project runs for 3 years. Both positions are purely temporary and end when the project is completed.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in PRSU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Junior Research Fellow (JRF) and 1 Project Fellow, both in the DST-SHRI project at the SoS in Ancient Indian History Culture and Archaeology.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the PRSU JRF and Project Fellow posts?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the department within one month from the date the advertisement is published in newspapers.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification do I need for the PRSU JRF post?
faq.answer: You need an M. A. in Ancient Indian History, Culture and Archaeology with CSIR/UGC NET. Field work experience in Archaeology is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification do I need for the PRSU Project Fellow post?
faq.answer: You need an M. Sc. in Chemistry and experience of handling analytical instruments. The notice lists both as essential qualifications.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the PRSU JRF and Project Fellow posts?
faq.answer: The monthly fellowship is Rs. 31,000/- + 20% HRA for the JRF and Rs. 25,000/- + 20% HRA for the Project Fellow.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the fellowship?
faq.answer: Yes. Both posts get 20% HRA on top of the monthly fellowship: Rs. 31,000/- for the JRF and Rs. 25,000/- for the Project Fellow.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for PRSU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Send your application with self-attested certificates, marksheets, degrees and experience certificates to Dr. Nitesh Kumar Mishra, SoS in Ancient Indian History Culture and Archaeology, Pt. Ravishankar Shukla University, Raipur. The notice also prints the email [email protected] with this address.

faq.question: Q8. Are the PRSU project posts permanent?
faq.answer: No. Both positions are purely temporary and end when the project is completed. The project tenure is 3 years.

faq.question: Q9. Will PRSU pay travel allowance for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA will be paid to candidates called for an interview.
